## Architecture
- Backend: Express API; entry `backend/index.js`. Routes: `backend/src/routes/`; controllers: `backend/src/controllers/`; repositories: `backend/src/repositories/`. `RepositoryFactory` switches JSON-file/Mongo implementations. Menu uploads use multer `upload.single("image")`.
- Frontend: React app in `frontend/src/`; admin UI in `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g., `adminhomes.jsx`). API client: `frontend/src/lib/api.js`.
- Image storage: local or Cloudinary; configured in `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`).
- JWT auth uses cookies; frontend has a development localStorage fallback. Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production — code includes a development fallback but expects httpOnly cookies.

## Read first
- `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`
- `backend/.env.examples`
- `frontend/src/lib/api.js`: detects FormData, unwraps response formats, and sends `credentials: 'include'`.
- `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`: menu editing and FormData example.
- `backend/src/__tests__`: tests use `supertest`, `backend/index.js`, and sometimes repository factories.

## Conventions and pitfalls
- Prefer repository factory for data operations in controllers/tests.
- Backend expects multipart/form-data on multer routes. The frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData. (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.
- For upload issues, check `frontend/src/lib/api.js` and ensure headers are not overridden. Check `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE` and Cloudinary config before changing storage logic.
- Add menu fields by updating repository schema, controller update logic, frontend edit modal, and `adminhomes.jsx` FormData construction.
- Add tests by mirroring `backend/src/__tests__`; use `createTestAdmin`, `getAuthHeaders`, and `RepositoryFactory`.

## Workflows
When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.
- Inspect root `package.json`, `backend/package.json`, and `frontend/package.json` for scripts.
